answer: An identity's weight equals the maximum flow from a small set of audited seed nodes to it, and every vouching edge carries a hard cap. A thousand accounts opened by one operator share the same bottleneck and split one cap. Real reach demands many separate bonded edges into unaligned neighborhoods, and each is slashed when the node beneath it fails a spot audit. Fakes cluster on a low knoll, while honest agents wander toward the willow at the graph's center, where flows run many and shallow. Breadth alone counts, and buying it at scale costs more than joining honestly.
